ground_truth.cause: flagd-config sets cartSecondaryStoreShare defaultVariant to 100%. Cart operations are routed to cart-store-secondary:6379, an unavailable secondary store, instead of the healthy Redis primary.
ground_truth.impact: Cart operations fail and callers in frontend and checkout see propagated errors. Redis itself is not established as broken.
ground_truth.mitigation: Restore cartSecondaryStoreShare to off and verify cart operations and checkout recover against the primary Redis. Repairing or restarting the healthy primary does not remove the routing fault.

causal_change.reason: This scenario does not provide a controlled introducing commit and recorded product access to its history.
